correctness.rationale: An algebraically exact proof determines full support, equality of bilinear Schur tensor dimensions, weighted partition blocks, cyclic shift-invariant congruence classes, a complete scalar recursion with wrap-around root condition, both directions of the incidence rule, and finite-field counts by cyclic multiplicative groups. Independent RREF subspace enumeration and normalized lattice tests corroborate all ingredients in explicitly bounded small cases.

value.rationale: The theorem computes a complete natural embedded-subalgebra lattice for all fields and all cycle lengths, including exact field-dependent inclusion relations and every finite-field dimension coefficient. The divisibility/root incidence gives mathematical information not entailed by known disjoint-support bases or rank-one formulas, and is a meaningful structural infinite-family classification.
